t: Effectively removes difficult adhesive deposits including gum, wax, wet paint, tape and sticker residue. Powerful gel spray solution which can be used on most surfaces including glass, wood, metal, worktops, fabrics and tiles. When removing sticky labels, gum or adhesive residue from hard surfaces, leave product on surface for 5-7 minutes. For removal of oil, grease, tar, crayon or similar stains from washable fabrics, apply product sparingly and leave for up to 10 minutes. Gel formulation to stick to vertical surfaces.
